project.purpose: Mobile-first Arabic pirate-persona track-discovery experience for a university orientation; visuals should follow the supplied screenshots without replacing real UI with screenshot images.

locales.mixed_language_instruction: Wrap English/acronyms (GDGoC, Builder, AASTMT) in dir=ltr or unicode bidi isolation; keep Arabic natural and correctly joined.

reference_usage.provided_images_are: visual-only reference screenshots; NOT production-ready cutouts, sprite sheets, or page backgrounds
never_do: Do not put screenshots behind transparent hotspots.
Do not rasterize Arabic headlines/buttons into static page screenshots.
Do not invent missing quiz questions or pretend a personality inference algorithm exists.
Do not use blurry low-resolution enlargements of reference cards as production artwork.
asset_priority: Existing project local artwork if present
New original pixel-art matching the provided silhouettes/palette if supplied later
CSS atmospheric fallback, while preserving readable functionality
reference_usage.asset_missing_behavior: Use an explicit non-blocking placeholder and document missing illustration files; do not silently use screenshot crops for responsive layouts.

visual_direction.art_style: Polished high-density pixel-art game interface, anime-inspired pirates, hand-crafted maritime props
visual_direction.mood: Adventurous, welcoming, energetic; not childish or photorealistic
visual_direction.pixel_art_handling: Use image-rendering:pixelated for intentionally low-res source art; avoid globally pixelating text or high-resolution assets.

typography.notes: Screenshot art suggests blocky/pixel lettering, but live Arabic typography must remain legible and properly shaped. Use a licensed Arabic pixel font only if it renders correctly.

border_style.primary: 2px warm dark outline with small stepped/chipped/pixel corners
border_style.implementation: Prefer nine-slice art or CSS pseudo-elements for RPG frame corners; preserve actual button HTML, focus, interaction.

ornamental_motion: Progress bar shimmer only when indeterminate
motion.reduced_motion: Disable looping float/flicker/parallax and replace progress animation with static state when prefers-reduced-motion.

software_engineering.character_description: Red-coated pirate engineer, black and red tricorne, practical leather straps and boots, anime pixel-art shading

artificial_intelligence.character_description: Blue-coated bespectacled pirate magician holding bright holographic neon-blue AI orb, cyan trim, dramatic flowing cape

responsive_rules.base_layout: 100dvh-capable screens; allow vertical overflow, never crop main actions; root inline-size:100%; max-width for content ~1180px; use viewport-fit=cover and safe-area padding.
responsive_rules.mobile: Single column, 16px outer gutters (12px on tiny), text never below 14px for primary reading, decorative layers behind main content.
responsive_rules.tablet: Increase hero imagery and content breathing room; split columns only when readable.
responsive_rules.desktop: Recreate wider poster-like compositions: layered characters, ship scenery, and result illustration beside text.
responsive_rules.touch: Minimum 44x44px interactive targets and at least 8px gaps; prevent accidental swipe takeover inside vertical page scroll.
responsive_rules.images: Responsive <picture>/srcset; character PNG/WebP transparent; background scene WebP/AVIF; pre-size images to avoid layout shifts.

shape.responses: Array<{questionId:string, optionId:string}>; one selected option per answered question
shape.status: idle | answering | submitting | analyzing | complete | error

flow.guard: initialize quiz session and load approved questions
answer passes input requirements; persist progress
all 8 answers present and result analysis has been initiated
known returned trackId; result source verified
show retry/back actions, never hang forever

application_state.persistence: Store the current question index and selected option IDs per question in sessionStorage (or opt-in localStorage) if persistence is desired; do not include responses in a public URL.

quiz_policy.selection: Four choices per question; exactly one option per question (radio behavior).
quiz_policy.question_data_source: Separate author-approved Arabic question bank or API. The screenshot provides question 3 only; questions 1, 2, 4–8 are not supplied.
quiz_policy.back_navigation: Persist previous selection and allow changing it.
quiz_policy.scoring_and_ai: Unspecified; provide integration contract/stub only. Do not hardcode a personality outcome or arbitrary weights.

result_policy.missing_result_behavior: Show approved generic fallback and flag incomplete copy; do not invent detailed strengths/traits.

accessibility.semantic_html: main/nav/header/section/button/form with accessible names; decorative scene aria-hidden
accessibility.rtl: Use dir=rtl on page and direction-aware margins/icons; preserve correct logical back/forward arrows in Arabic UI.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure parchment text >=4.5:1; translucent panel backgrounds opaque enough over illustrations
accessibility.keyboard: Visible focus ring; keyboard-selectable native radio option cards and accessible Back/Next navigation.
accessibility.performance: Do not block largest text paint on hero image; preload only current screen and most relevant art.

delivery_acceptance: Each screen can be reconstructed from real HTML/CSS components and optimized independent artwork, not screenshot overlays.
At 320px wide and 390px wide all Arabic text is uncut and calls to action are clickable.
Desktop layout resembles its corresponding provided screenshot while mobile remains purpose-built.
Each track uses the correct character, icon and theme and never mixes colors.
A screen-reader can announce page title, quiz progress, question and status changes.
No invented unanswered question bank, result-scoring algorithm, or fake loading progress.
The personality quiz is MCQ-only: four single-select answer cards per question; Next requires a selection and Back restores it; no free-text composer.
